constraint: ed3c/noodles#415 - the type coordinate's refusal surface, and TRUSTED POLICY exactly the way
policy/ruff.toml is: type_gate_errors resolves this file under policy_root and the sources
under root, so a candidate that rewrites it is still judged by the default branch's copy and
its policy change becomes authority only from the next PR onward. The gate never hands
basedpyright a directory the candidate controls: it materializes the candidate's tracked
Python into a scratch tree and drops THESE bytes in beside it as basedpyrightconfig.json, so
a candidate-side config cannot win by proximity or by name. JSON carries no comments, so the
reasons live in this key; basedpyright ignores unrecognized config keys, measured on 1.39.10.
The version pin and the frozen debt live in policy/basedpyright-baseline.json rather than
here, because this file's bytes are consumed verbatim by the tool and the pin is ours.

reasons.typeCheckingMode: recommended is basedpyright's every-rule mode, which is what makes the reportUnknown* family, reportAny, reportExplicitAny, reportUnreachable, reportUnusedCallResult and reportMatchNotExhaustive all live at once. The named rules below are pinned explicitly anyway, so a future mode change cannot drop one of the adjudicated set silently - the same reason policy/ruff.toml names groups instead of ALL.
reasons.reportUnreachable: a branch no test can ever cover, which no lint and no coverage report can tell apart from one that is merely untested.
reasons.reportUnusedCallResult: this codebase's contract modules return receipt dicts and error lists; a discarded return is a check nobody read.
reasons.reportMatchNotExhaustive: a state added to a union with no arm to receive it is the silent-collapse shape the multi-state gates elsewhere exist to refuse.
reasons.reportUnknownMemberType: dict[str, Any] payloads crossing module seams are this repository's production risk shape, per the atom's trigger. Baseline-frozen, not mass-cleaned.
reasons.reportUnknownArgumentType: same family, same freeze: it is where a caller and callee stop agreeing.
reasons.reportAny: the honest measure of how much of the tree is unchecked. Frozen, never mass-cleaned: burn-down is later atoms' work at the pace of the surfaces that own it.
reasons.reportExplicitAny: the deliberate Any-shaped payloads policy/ruff.toml's ANN401 exclusion already names. Frozen for the same reason and never converted into noise.
reasons.reportIgnoreCommentWithoutRule: the suppression discipline's tool-side half: a rule-less `# pyright: ignore` is refused by basedpyright itself.
reasons.reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment: the other tool-side half: a suppression that suppresses nothing is refused, so the escape hatch cannot outlive the diagnostic it was written for.
reasons.enableTypeIgnoreComments: false, so a bare `# type: ignore` suppresses NOTHING and the diagnostic it was reaching for surfaces anyway. type_gate_errors refuses the comment itself as well; neither carrier is the other's proof.
reasons.pythonVersion: 3.11 is the floor `noodles` requires (tomllib) and the version its judgements must hold at; CI runs 3.12.
reasons.include: the scratch tree the gate materializes, never a path the candidate names.
